item.title: Slipknot’s M. Shawn Crahan Reveals He Needs Heart Surgery
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show, where we bring you the latest music news. Today, we're talking about Slipknot's M. Shawn Crahan, also known as Clown. The 56-year-old percussionist recently shared some personal health news that's got fans concerned.
[Music transitions to a softer tone]
Host: Crahan revealed that he's been diagnosed with a cardiac condition, which was discovered after the band's recent tour. He spoke about it in an interview on Rick Rubin's Tetragrammaton podcast. According to Crahan, his heart has an electrical issue that causes it to skip beats, leading to sudden drops in heart rate that leave him feeling unwell.
[Soft music continues]
Host: Crahan explained that his heart rate can drop to as low as 33 beats per minute during the day, and 43 at night. He joked that his brain is so strong that it's been able to manage the condition, but he knows he needs to take care of it. The good news is that the surgery to fix the issue is relatively simple and can be done on an outpatient basis.
[Music transitions to a more upbeat tone]
Host: Despite the initial shock, Crahan is staying positive and grateful for the medical care he's receiving. As a member of Slipknot, he has access to specialized doctors who are helping him get back on track. And, as he puts it, he's lucky to be able to do what he loves, and he's not going to let his heart condition get in the way.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's the latest on M. Shawn Crahan's health. We wish him all the best and a speedy recovery. You can check out his full interview on Rick Rubin's Tetragrammaton podcast for more on his story.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
